signup_ok: Signup successful. Please check your email for the verification code.
verification_code_resent: A new verification code has been sent to your email.
registration_ok: Registered. Your Discord role is on its way.
registration_ok_team: Team registered. Discord roles are on their way.
registration_pending_sponsor: Registered. Your registration is waiting for the sponsor's approval.
registration_waitlisted: Event is full. You have been added to the waitlist.
registration_waitlisted_team: Event is full. Your team has been added to the waitlist.
reset_token_sent: A password reset code has been sent to your email.
reset_token_resent: A new password reset code has been sent to your email.
team_name_needs_letter: A team name needs at least one letter or number.
team_name_reserved: That name belongs to a page on AFC. Please choose another name.
email_invalid: That email address does not look right. Please check it.
claims_not_open_yet: Results for this map open when its group starts playing.
claims_closed: Results for this map are closed: the organizer's time for sending them has passed.
attach_game_file: Attach a debugger or result file.
game_file_too_large: That file is too large to send. Add it again from the box, it compresses it first.
game_file_unreadable: That file is too large or damaged.
not_a_game_file: That is not a debugger file or a match result file.
game_files_ids_required: Send the ids of the files you added.
game_files_expired: These files were read too long ago. Add them again.
game_not_in_files: That game is not in these files.
game_files_bad_choices: The choices for that game could not be read.
placements_not_one_each: Each placement can be used once: 1 for the winner, then 2, 3 and so on.
no_files_for_game: There is nothing to upload for that game.
match_not_on_event: That match is not on this event.
game_log_not_result: This is a game log, not a match result file. Add it in Game files: it reads the whole game the way AFC Capture does and asks for any file it still needs.
replay_file_unreadable: That replay file is too large or damaged.
replay_name_needed: Keep the replay file's own name (ReplayInfo_<match>_<date>.bin) so it can be paired with its map.
board_group_not_found: That group is not part of this event.
board_maps_invalid: Maps must be chosen from this group.
